editorial:
Imagine a killer who is so good at lying and changing his look that even the best police task force cannot find him. You get to follow James Becket, a scary guy who killed his own dad and is now hunting down his ex-wife, Tess. It feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where the bad guy is always one step ahead. Luckily, Tess has J.T. Dillon in her corner. He is a former cop who teaches her how to fight back, and the two of them end up falling in love while trying to survive this nightmare. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure as the killer closes in.

What really works here is the tension and the way the action picks up toward the end. The acting is solid, and you will find yourself rooting for J.T. to finally catch Becket. While some parts of the plot feel a bit predictable, the final showdown makes up for it. If you love thrillers with a bit of romance and plenty of suspense, you should definitely check this out. You can grab a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection or just rent it on Apple TV for a movie night in. It looks great in high definition, so try to find a 4K Ultra HD stream on Prime Video if you can.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Becket kidnaps the detective's wife to force a final fight. J.T. and the police track him down for a violent showdown. After a tense struggle, J.T. uses the skills he taught Tess and his own police training to outsmart the killer. Becket is finally stopped, ending his reign of terror. Tess and J.T. survive the ordeal, finding peace and safety now that the threat is gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cat-and-mouse thrillers and strong lead characters.
